Below it, add black text: 'From the separability point of view data can be classified into :' with 'data can be classified into' in bold. 8. Add three bullet points down the left side: 'Linearly Separable', 'Non-Linearly Separable', 'Non-Separable'. 9. To the right of each bullet, draw a thick red right-pointing arrow. 10. To the right of each arrow, place the notes respectively: '(Use Linear classifier)', '(Use Non-Linear classifier)', '(Use Kernels with Classifiers)' in black text.
